import ctypes

# Load the dynamic libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the argument and return types for gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv
gsl.gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv.restype = ctypes.c_double

# Define the argument and return types for gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv
gsl.gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double, ctypes.c_double]
gsl.gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv.restype = ctypes.c_double

def gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv(P, a, b):
    """Python wrapper for the gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv function."""
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv(P, a, b)

def gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv(Q, a, b):
    """Python wrapper for the gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv function."""
    return gsl.gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv(Q, a, b)

def assert_test():
    """Test cases to validate the correctness of the functions."""
    # Test gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv
    assert abs(gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv(0.5, 0.0, 1.0) - 0.5) < 1e-9, "Test case 1 failed for gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv"
    assert abs(gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv(0.0, 0.0, 1.0) - 0.0) < 1e-9, "Test case 2 failed for gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv"
    assert abs(gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv(1.0, 0.0, 1.0) - 1.0) < 1e-9, "Test case 3 failed for gsl_cdf_flat_Pinv"

    # Test gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv
    assert abs(gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv(0.5, 0.0, 1.0) - 0.5) < 1e-9, "Test case 1 failed for gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv"
    assert abs(gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv(0.0, 0.0, 1.0) - 1.0) < 1e-9, "Test case 2 failed for gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv"
    assert abs(gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv(1.0, 0.0, 1.0) - 0.0) < 1e-9, "Test case 3 failed for gsl_cdf_flat_Qinv"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
    print("All tests passed.")
